_comment: quality_suffix is appended to EVERY image-generation prompt (Cloudflare FLUX, Gemini, Pollinations); it is never skipped. Keep everything positive (say what you want): image models draw whatever the prompt names. style_dna is the look every picture shares. variants are visual families built from reference images you liked: each picture uses ONE family (rotated, never the same one twice in a row), takes at most two of its elements, and must add one new element from that day's topic, so pictures match in style but never copy a reference. The chosen family is saved on the draft as image.style_id and compared in the weekly learning review. Do not put text, numbers, brand names or layout words (panel, grid, section, column, diagram) in here.
quality_suffix: Ultra-sharp 4K resolution, highly detailed, crisp focus, clean edges, cinematic lighting with soft glow, rich contrast, high dynamic range, premium polished finish, vertical 4:5 composition.
style_dna: Premium, polished, high-contrast technology look with one clear glowing accent colour, clean modern shapes, a cinematic feel, and a large calm area across the lower 40% of the frame.

variants.name: glass interface cards
variants.look: a near-black or deep navy background with soft neon rim light and a gentle glow
variants.elements: a few floating glass-like interface cards in soft perspective, showing only blank bars, simple glowing line charts and round icons, with a glowing reflection on the floor below

variants.name: person and glowing intelligence
variants.look: a deep indigo darkness with soft blue and violet light and drifting particles
variants.elements: a person in profile as a dark silhouette at a desk, facing softly glowing translucent shapes, drifting light particles and thin network lines

variants.name: glowing network
variants.look: a pure black background with crisp white and cyan light
variants.elements: a constellation of bright nodes joined by thin lines, flowing light waves, and sharp angled geometric shapes in white and the accent colour, with generous dark empty space

variants.name: moody desk scene
variants.look: a dark, quiet room lit by one warm lamp, rich shadows and a subtle glow
variants.elements: a laptop with a softly glowing dark screen on a dark desk, a black ceramic mug, a closed notebook and pen, a warm lamp glow and a leafy plant fading into the dark background

variants.name: bright minimal desk
variants.look: soft natural daylight from a window, calm neutral tones, shallow depth of field
variants.elements: a light wooden desk, a laptop with a dark glowing interface, a white ceramic mug, an open notebook with a pen, a small plant and a soft window glow
